Sentence (English): I did not have enough dirty dishes to start my new Bosch dishwasher today.
Comments (English): [ First impressions ] || ---------------- || I did not have enough dirty dishes to start my new Bosch dishwasher today. This 100 series machine really isn't the same as my old one. I'm sure I will soon love it. I read all about the way to use the control panel and just scraping the dishes (no rincing). Also the need to use a granulated or liquid soap if I select a shorter washing cycle and always use a jet dry rince aid. I was not doing these with my old Bosch. I must also say the little gray utensils rack upper grid is not large enough to let in my every day forks, spoons, etc. and when I lift the grid the utensils are too close together. So I had to reinstall my old Bosch rack wich I kept in case. Unfortunately the model I chose does not either include a third upper large space for utensils to lie on.

Sentence (English): I purchased this to replace a 15 year old plastic tub Whirlpool dishwasher that finally kicked the bucket.
Comments (English): [ Pleased With The Purchase ] || ---------------- || I purchased this to replace a 15 year old plastic tub Whirlpool dishwasher that finally kicked the bucket. The previous Whirlpool was installed professionally whereas I installed this myself, and I'm glad I did. I found that the previous installer took a few shortcuts - no strain relief on the hard wire hook-up - stripped 3 inches of bare wire on the hard wire - and had the water line in with 3 extra feet of line crammed under the dishwasher. The installation was fairly easy considering we have a dated kitchen.We've had the unit about a month now, and we are very pleased with it so far. We use it maybe 3 times a week in our empty nest as we wait until it's fairly full before using. Sound level and washing ability are great. pleased with the drying too. We ordered this directly from KitchenAid on their website because the price was better than the big box stores plus we got free delivery. We looked at dishwashers on the floor locally before we purchased, and we took into account reviews we read on-line.I was undecided.

Comments (English): I was satisfied with the purchasing process, the product, and the professional installation. However, there are some areas regarding usability that I would like to see improved. My parents are currently using it, and since they live alone, they don't use many dishes. They tend to wash dishes immediately whenever they have them, so they say they rarely use the top and bottom sections. For users like them, it would be helpful if the installer could explain how to wash quickly using only the top and bottom sections. It would be even more effective if they also mentioned that it uses less water than standard dishwashing. Additionally, they seem to have a reluctance to use detergent, especially rinse aid. It would be good to explain drying methods without rinse aid after washing (such as taking the dishes out halfway through to wipe them with a towel or leaving the door open) during the installation. Recently, I washed dishes with fish, and there was a strong fishy smell afterward, so I had to wash them again. While I acknowledge that it uses less water, I hope options to improve deodorizing performance, such as removing fishy odors, will be implemented.

Sentence (English): This dish washer has not been the best since we bought it.
Comments (English): [ Would not recommend ] || ---------------- || This dish washer has not been the best since we bought it. It doesn't always clean the dishes and we've tried loading it in as many different ways as we can to try eliminating user error. The seals around the door traps any grease or food and forms a moldy build up that has to periodically be scooped out and sanitized. The filter is easily removable but gets clogged easily so you'll be removing it frequently. The dish washer does not drain completely so there will always be a little bit of water sitting around the filter and it will start to smell if you don't run frequent empty cycles with vinegar to clean it. The water pick up tube at the back that provides water to the top rack spinner is supposed to be secured with two screws and it was only secured with one. I purchased this in August 2023 and here in Aug 2025 it has started to turn itself off mid cycle. We've had to check it repeatedly when it has stopped running to see if the dishes were done or if it just quit. Numerous times it has just decided to quit running so it's been about 2 years and we'll need to replace this expensive junk. This is advertised in the $500-700 normal price range but is nearly always on sale for around $300. Whether its $300 or $600 is sort of irrelevant for the following point. It's just too expensive to have to replace every 2 years if that's all these things are good for. Only having a 1 year warranty should be a sign that this product is not meant to last. GE builds rockets and Jet engines but they can't seem to build quality appliances that last. Then again, there have been a lot more aircraft accidents in the last several years so they might be slipping in more than one area of their business.

Sentence (English): After months of debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher, I finally bought one.
Comments (English): [ I like the buttons better than the touch screen, and it's bigger than I thought, but I'm very satisfied~ ] || ---------------- || After months of debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher, I finally bought one. True to the BESPOKE series, the design is luxurious, and the size is just right. The clean white glass color makes the kitchen feel much more organized. The installer came in person and did a thorough job, and they even conducted a noise test, which made my first impression positive. The capacity is perfect for a couple or a family of three, with a capacity of six. It's full enough to handle one or two days' worth of dishes, and the well-divided compartments make it easy to organize plates, cups, chopsticks, and other items. The cleaning power is impressive. Pre-rinsing greasy pans and pots ensures they're thoroughly cleaned. The automatic drying process allows you to remove and put away dishes right away. Previously, I'd have to wipe water stains with a towel after washing dishes, but this one eliminates that hassle altogether. It's also much quieter than I expected. I can even have a conversation while it's running, and it's not at all annoying, even when running at night. It also uses less water, which is environmentally friendly. The sterilization cycle is especially helpful for families with children. There's almost no odor or detergent residue, and the interior is clean after washing. The only downside is that if the pot is too large, it won't fit properly. And if you open the door right after washing, a bit of steam remains. However, if you leave it open for a moment, it dries quickly. My kitchen, which used to be a pain to clean, is now much cleaner, and dishwashing time has been reduced, making my day much easier. I'm so satisfied with the design, performance, and noise level, so I'm really glad I bought this product. These days, I don't have to worry about washing dishes after eating. Comments (English): [ Very angry. ] || ---------------- || We got this dishwasher with our new house a little over two years ago, and right after the warranty expired, the motor broke. Sentence (English): Old Whirlpool needed new circulation pump, decided to replace.
Comments (English): [ Fine replacement for old machine. ] || ---------------- || Old Whirlpool needed new circulation pump, decided to replace. This unit fit the space and wanted front controls since nearly flush with countertop edge. Swap was straightforward, but took afternoon to adapt hoses to new style fittings. New machine washes dishes fine for a couple weeks, still getting used to different feel of new door spring/damper. Auto-door opener is a nice way to signal cycle is done since the machine is pleasantly quiet. Minimal options for cycles is fine with me, I just use the regular cycle + 4 hour delay to run overnight. Touch-buttons work solid. Fancy rack design works fine, seems a little overdone to my old school expectations. The only feature I miss from the old washer is 2 hour delay option, not a big deal since it quiet running. I bought from local retailer, price seemed in-line with general expectation for this class of washers.

The dish drying rack next to the water purifier is the perfect size and sits nicely in the spot where it used to be. It was surprisingly larger than I expected, but since the dishes piled up here and there are no longer visible, the kitchen looks neater. The drain hose was also attached to one side of the sink. I wasted a lot of water. But with the dishwasher, I only have to pre-soak the dishes all at once, which saves water! *Loads everything from the inner pot to the frying pan! Other brands had two-tier stackable models, but after reading reviews, I saw that even slightly larger models wouldn't fit pots, so I chose Samsung, which has a single tier. It fits a small frying pan, a rice cooker inner pot, and all the basic pots! *Easy to operate: Simple operations like turning on/off/add a course, as well as adding detergent and cleaning the filter. It's so easy to operate that I even showed my husband how to use it in advance. *Noise(?) My child slept soundly without waking up. *Automatic door opening/drying: The door automatically opens to remove moisture/water inside, so I think I can go out with peace of mind. It doesn't dry it hot and fluffy like a dryer. *I'm very satisfied with it. I had a hard time with wrist pain and leg swelling from washing dishes three times a day, so I'm so glad I bought it now.

Comments (English): [ I prefer buttons to touch, and although it's bigger than I expected, I'm very satisfied. ] || ---------------- || After debating for months whether or not to buy a dishwasher, I finally made the purchase. True to the BESPOKE series, the design is luxurious, and the size is just right. The clean white glass color makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. The technician came in person for a neat installation, and they even conducted a thorough noise test, so I had a great first impression. The capacity is for 6 people, which is really suitable for a couple or a family of three. It fills up completely if you run a load of dishes for one or two days. The compartments are well-divided, making it easy to separate and store plates, cups, chopsticks, and more. The cleaning power is definitely excellent. If you rinse heavily greasy frying pans or pots beforehand, they are cleaned perfectly. Since drying is automatic, you can take everything out and put it away immediately. Previously, I had to wipe water stains with a towel after washing, but with this, there is absolutely no such hassle. The noise was also much quieter than I expected. It is quiet enough to have a conversation right next to it while it is running, and it is not bothersome at all even when running it at night. It uses less water, so I am satisfied with it from an environmental perspective as well. In particular, the sterilization course makes it safe for households with babies. It effectively removes odors and leaves almost no detergent residue, and the interior remains spotless after washing. The only downside is that very large pots don't fit well inside. Also, if you open the door immediately after washing, a little steam remains. However, if you leave it open for a moment, it dries quickly. My kitchen, which used to be a hassle to clean, is now much cleaner, and reducing dishwashing time has made my day much easier. I am satisfied with the design, performance, and noise level, so I am really glad I bought this product. Nowadays, I don't worry about washing dishes even after meals. It has truly changed my quality of life.

Comments (English): [ It’s perfect for a small kitchen in a household of three. ] || ---------------- || *This is a review based on my own purchase. I spent a lot of time deliberating and comparing options before buying this dishwasher. As a household of three (two adults and one child), a 12-place setting model was too big and there wasn't enough space. Plus, constantly having to "Tetris" the dish rack on the countertop was a hassle, so I decided to buy this. *A cleaner kitchen. It fits perfectly in the spot next to the water purifier where the dish rack used to be. It has settled in nicely. I was surprised by how large it was, but the kitchen looks much cleaner now that the dishes that used to pile up everywhere after washing are out of sight. They even attached the drain hose to one side of the sink. The sink used to be overflowing with unwashed dishes, but it is so great that I can just rinse them and put them in right after a meal. *Water saving. I used to waste so much water by pre-soaking and soaking dishes after meals, running the water all day to wash them, and repeating that three times a day. But using the dishwasher saves water because I can just pre-wash everything at once and put them in! *Fills everything from the inner pot to the frying pan! Other brands had models that allowed for two-tier stacking, but after reading reviews saying that even slightly larger items wouldn't fit and pots couldn't be put in, I chose the single-tier Samsung model. Small frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, and all the standard pots fit inside! *Easy Operation. It is really easy to operate, with simple controls like power, course selection, and adding courses, as well as instructions on how to add detergent and clean the filter. I even taught my husband how to use it in advance. *Noise(?). Honestly, I tend to be sensitive to noise, but the sound of the dishwasher running isn't unpleasant. It doesn't rattle like a washing machine; it just sounds like water sloshing. My child slept soundly without waking up. *Automatic Door Opening/Drying. The door opens automatically to remove internal moisture and water, so I feel safe leaving the house. Sentence (English): So far, we have enjoyed this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Not Too Shabby ] || ---------------- || So far, we have enjoyed this dishwasher. It replaced a 25 year old Whirlpool. We used to have to run our dishwasher overnight because it was so loud. This one is so quiet we can run it whenever. But we do prefer to run it at night so the Auto Air Dry feature has time to allow the dishes to fully dry. For the most part, the dishes come dry by the end of the normal cycle, but letting them fully air out and dry overnight works out better. We like that we can configure our dishes in the racks in many ways giving much flexibility. And the third rack can hold lots of silverware and other large flat utensils. However at times not all the silverware comes clean. I assume it because the dishes in the top rack block the water from reaching above it to the third. But this is a minor issue to us. Overall we like how quiet it is, how well it cleans our dishes and the different cycle options. Oh, and the app allows you to track how much time is left in a cycle. I enjoy that, and the additonal options it offers including delay start. We think you will like this dishwasher as well.

Sentence (English): I live alone.
Comments (English): I live alone. It's the fate of living alone. Washing dishes. It's such a hassle, especially the grease that gets on plastic containers! I'm not the only one who hates washing dishes with a mixture of baking soda and detergent and hot water, right? It gets my hands hot and takes forever. This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. (별도 세제통이 없어서 더 편해요) 작년에 미닉스 전용 세제가 리뉴얼 중이라 이걸 사봤는데, 아직 한 박스나 남아서..ㅎㅎ 다 쓰면 리뉴얼된 미닉스 세제도 써보려구요!  사용법도 진짜 간단해요. 먼저 전원플러그 꼽고 전원을 켜면, 디스플레이 우측 버튼으로 모드를 선택할 수 있어요. (표준, 강력, 쾌속, 내부세척 등등) 저는 성격이 급해서 쾌속도 써봤는데, 밥그릇 국그릇 정도는 괜찮지만 기름기 묻은 건 역시 표준 모드가 짱이더라구요.ㅎㅎ 그래서 99% 표준 모드만 사용해요! 이걸로도 충분히 말끔하게 닦여요.  아, 그리고 처음 구매해서 설치하면 동봉된 내부 세척용 세제를 넣고 내부 세척을 한 번 하고 난 뒤에 사용하시는 걸 추천드려요!  물론 미니 사이즈라서 커다란 냄비나 후라이팬은 안 들어가요ㅠ 작은 냄비(라면 1개 끓이는 정도?)는 가능한데, 큰 건 무리! 그래서 냄비나 후라이팬은 그냥 제가 직접 설거지를 해요ㅎㅎ 그래도 자잘자잘한 설거지거리가 싹 없어진 것만으로도 행복합니다.  기본이 무타공 설치지만, 옵션으로 타공해서 직수 연결도 가능하더라구요. (저는 해당 없음!ㅋㅋ) 요새 저 같은 1인가구가 엄청 많아졌잖아요. 내 집도 아닌데 타공하긴 어렵고, 큰 용량이 부담스러운 분들께 정말 강력 추천드려요!! 설거지 양 많지 않은 신혼부부나 딩크족분들께도 완전 추천!  진짜 편하고 좋아요. 기름기 완전 타파~~ 여러분들도 '미닉스 식기세척기' 이모님 들이시고 편한 생활하세요~~~

Sentence (English): This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle!
Comments (English): I live alone. It's the fate of living alone. Washing dishes. It's such a hassle, especially the grease that gets on plastic containers! I'm not the only one who hates washing dishes with a mixture of baking soda and detergent and hot water, right? It gets my hands hot and takes forever. This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.

This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.
Comments (Original): 저는 혼자 자취 중에 있는데요. 자취생의 숙명... 설거지... 정말 귀찮잖아요ㅠ 특히 플라스틱 용기에 묻은 기름기 같은 거요! 매번 베이킹소다랑 세제 섞어서 뜨거운 물로 닦는 거, 저만 싫은 거 아니죠? 손은 뜨겁고 시간은 오래 걸리고... 이 귀찮음에서 저를 해방시켜준 게 바로 이 미닉스 식기세척기입니다!!  정말 저희 집 주방이모 두 분 중 한 분으로 당당히 자리 잡았어요.ㅎㅎ  무엇보다 제가 전세 집이라 벽에 구멍을 뚫거나(타공) 시공하는 게 불가능했거든요. 그래서 설치가 간편한 무타공 제품을 찾았는데 이게 딱이더라구요! 그냥 전원 꼽고 물만 부어주면 되니까 저 같은 1인 가구 자취생이나 이사 자주 다니는 분들께는 이만한 게 없어요. 타공 걱정 없이 식세기를 쓸 수 있다니, 진짜 삶의 질이 달라졌어요.ㅎㅎ 말로만 좋다고 하면 안 믿으실까 봐ㅋㅋ 제가 세척력 테스트를 제대로 해봤어요. 평소에는 간단히 애벌 설거지를 하고 넣는데, 이번엔 리얼 후기를 위해 그냥 넣어봤습니다! (두근) 으... 돼지기름이랑 말라붙은 소스라니... 솔직히 굳은 머스타드는 잘 닦일까 살짝 걱정됐어요ㅋㅋㅋ  세제는 프로쉬 베이킹소다를 쓰는데요. 독일 제품이기도 하고, 기름기 제거에 아주 탁월해요.  저는 3인용 식기세척기라 타블렛을 미리 반으로 다 잘라놨어요. 요걸 그냥 바닥 아무데나 툭 던져주면 준비 끝! (별도 세제통이 없어서 더 편해요) 작년에 미닉스 전용 세제가 리뉴얼 중이라 이걸 사봤는데, 아직 한 박스나 남아서..ㅎㅎ 다 쓰면 리뉴얼된 미닉스 세제도 써보려구요!  사용법도 진짜 간단해요. 먼저 전원플러그 꼽고 전원을 켜면, 디스플레이 우측 버튼으로 모드를 선택할 수 있어요. (표준, 강력, 쾌속, 내부세척 등등) 저는 성격이 급해서 쾌속도 써봤는데, 밥그릇 국그릇 정도는 괜찮지만 기름기 묻은 건 역시 표준 모드가 짱이더라구요.ㅎㅎ 그래서 99% 표준 모드만 사용해요! 이걸로도 충분히 말끔하게 닦여요.  아, 그리고 처음 구매해서 설치하면 동봉된 내부 세척용 세제를 넣고 내부 세척을 한 번 하고 난 뒤에 사용하시는 걸 추천드려요!  물론 미니 사이즈라서 커다란 냄비나 후라이팬은 안 들어가요ㅠ 작은 냄비(라면 1개 끓이는 정도?)는 가능한데, 큰 건 무리! 그래서 냄비나 후라이팬은 그냥 제가 직접 설거지를 해요ㅎㅎ 그래도 자잘자잘한 설거지거리가 싹 없어진 것만으로도 행복합니다.  기본이 무타공 설치지만, 옵션으로 타공해서 직수 연결도 가능하더라구요. (저는 해당 없음!ㅋㅋ) 요새 저 같은 1인가구가 엄청 많아졌잖아요. 내 집도 아닌데 타공하긴 어렵고, 큰 용량이 부담스러운 분들께 정말 강력 추천드려요!! 설거지 양 많지 않은 신혼부부나 딩크족분들께도 완전 추천!  진짜 편하고 좋아요. 기름기 완전 타파~~ 여러분들도 '미닉스 식기세척기' 이모님 들이시고 편한 생활하세요~~~

Sentence (English): For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution.
Comments (English): I live alone. It's the fate of living alone. Washing dishes. It's such a hassle, especially the grease that gets on plastic containers! I'm not the only one who hates washing dishes with a mixture of baking soda and detergent and hot water, right? It gets my hands hot and takes forever. This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.

(별도 세제통이 없어서 더 편해요) 작년에 미닉스 전용 세제가 리뉴얼 중이라 이걸 사봤는데, 아직 한 박스나 남아서..ㅎㅎ 다 쓰면 리뉴얼된 미닉스 세제도 써보려구요!  사용법도 진짜 간단해요. 먼저 전원플러그 꼽고 전원을 켜면, 디스플레이 우측 버튼으로 모드를 선택할 수 있어요. (표준, 강력, 쾌속, 내부세척 등등) 저는 성격이 급해서 쾌속도 써봤는데, 밥그릇 국그릇 정도는 괜찮지만 기름기 묻은 건 역시 표준 모드가 짱이더라구요.ㅎㅎ 그래서 99% 표준 모드만 사용해요! 이걸로도 충분히 말끔하게 닦여요.  아, 그리고 처음 구매해서 설치하면 동봉된 내부 세척용 세제를 넣고 내부 세척을 한 번 하고 난 뒤에 사용하시는 걸 추천드려요!  물론 미니 사이즈라서 커다란 냄비나 후라이팬은 안 들어가요ㅠ 작은 냄비(라면 1개 끓이는 정도?)는 가능한데, 큰 건 무리! 그래서 냄비나 후라이팬은 그냥 제가 직접 설거지를 해요ㅎㅎ 그래도 자잘자잘한 설거지거리가 싹 없어진 것만으로도 행복합니다.  기본이 무타공 설치지만, 옵션으로 타공해서 직수 연결도 가능하더라구요. (저는 해당 없음!ㅋㅋ) 요새 저 같은 1인가구가 엄청 많아졌잖아요. 내 집도 아닌데 타공하긴 어렵고, 큰 용량이 부담스러운 분들께 정말 강력 추천드려요!! 설거지 양 많지 않은 신혼부부나 딩크족분들께도 완전 추천!  진짜 편하고 좋아요. 기름기 완전 타파~~ 여러분들도 '미닉스 식기세척기' 이모님 들이시고 편한 생활하세요~~~

Sentence (English): It's a German product and excellent at removing grease.
Comments (English): I live alone. It's the fate of living alone. Washing dishes. It's such a hassle, especially the grease that gets on plastic containers! I'm not the only one who hates washing dishes with a mixture of baking soda and detergent and hot water, right? It gets my hands hot and takes forever. This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.

This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.
Comments (Original): 저는 혼자 자취 중에 있는데요. 자취생의 숙명... 설거지... 정말 귀찮잖아요ㅠ 특히 플라스틱 용기에 묻은 기름기 같은 거요! 매번 베이킹소다랑 세제 섞어서 뜨거운 물로 닦는 거, 저만 싫은 거 아니죠? 손은 뜨겁고 시간은 오래 걸리고... 이 귀찮음에서 저를 해방시켜준 게 바로 이 미닉스 식기세척기입니다!!  정말 저희 집 주방이모 두 분 중 한 분으로 당당히 자리 잡았어요.ㅎㅎ  무엇보다 제가 전세 집이라 벽에 구멍을 뚫거나(타공) 시공하는 게 불가능했거든요. 그래서 설치가 간편한 무타공 제품을 찾았는데 이게 딱이더라구요! 그냥 전원 꼽고 물만 부어주면 되니까 저 같은 1인 가구 자취생이나 이사 자주 다니는 분들께는 이만한 게 없어요. 타공 걱정 없이 식세기를 쓸 수 있다니, 진짜 삶의 질이 달라졌어요.ㅎㅎ 말로만 좋다고 하면 안 믿으실까 봐ㅋㅋ 제가 세척력 테스트를 제대로 해봤어요. 평소에는 간단히 애벌 설거지를 하고 넣는데, 이번엔 리얼 후기를 위해 그냥 넣어봤습니다! (두근) 으... 돼지기름이랑 말라붙은 소스라니... 솔직히 굳은 머스타드는 잘 닦일까 살짝 걱정됐어요ㅋㅋㅋ  세제는 프로쉬 베이킹소다를 쓰는데요. 독일 제품이기도 하고, 기름기 제거에 아주 탁월해요.  저는 3인용 식기세척기라 타블렛을 미리 반으로 다 잘라놨어요. 요걸 그냥 바닥 아무데나 툭 던져주면 준비 끝! (별도 세제통이 없어서 더 편해요) 작년에 미닉스 전용 세제가 리뉴얼 중이라 이걸 사봤는데, 아직 한 박스나 남아서..ㅎㅎ 다 쓰면 리뉴얼된 미닉스 세제도 써보려구요!  사용법도 진짜 간단해요. 먼저 전원플러그 꼽고 전원을 켜면, 디스플레이 우측 버튼으로 모드를 선택할 수 있어요. (표준, 강력, 쾌속, 내부세척 등등) 저는 성격이 급해서 쾌속도 써봤는데, 밥그릇 국그릇 정도는 괜찮지만 기름기 묻은 건 역시 표준 모드가 짱이더라구요.ㅎㅎ 그래서 99% 표준 모드만 사용해요! 이걸로도 충분히 말끔하게 닦여요.  아, 그리고 처음 구매해서 설치하면 동봉된 내부 세척용 세제를 넣고 내부 세척을 한 번 하고 난 뒤에 사용하시는 걸 추천드려요!  물론 미니 사이즈라서 커다란 냄비나 후라이팬은 안 들어가요ㅠ 작은 냄비(라면 1개 끓이는 정도?)는 가능한데, 큰 건 무리! 그래서 냄비나 후라이팬은 그냥 제가 직접 설거지를 해요ㅎㅎ 그래도 자잘자잘한 설거지거리가 싹 없어진 것만으로도 행복합니다.  기본이 무타공 설치지만, 옵션으로 타공해서 직수 연결도 가능하더라구요. (저는 해당 없음!ㅋㅋ) 요새 저 같은 1인가구가 엄청 많아졌잖아요. 내 집도 아닌데 타공하긴 어렵고, 큰 용량이 부담스러운 분들께 정말 강력 추천드려요!! 설거지 양 많지 않은 신혼부부나 딩크족분들께도 완전 추천!  진짜 편하고 좋아요. 기름기 완전 타파~~ 여러분들도 '미닉스 식기세척기' 이모님 들이시고 편한 생활하세요~~~

Sentence (English): I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out!
Comments (English): I live alone. It's the fate of living alone. Washing dishes. It's such a hassle, especially the grease that gets on plastic containers! I'm not the only one who hates washing dishes with a mixture of baking soda and detergent and hot water, right? It gets my hands hot and takes forever. This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.

(별도 세제통이 없어서 더 편해요) 작년에 미닉스 전용 세제가 리뉴얼 중이라 이걸 사봤는데, 아직 한 박스나 남아서..ㅎㅎ 다 쓰면 리뉴얼된 미닉스 세제도 써보려구요!  사용법도 진짜 간단해요. 먼저 전원플러그 꼽고 전원을 켜면, 디스플레이 우측 버튼으로 모드를 선택할 수 있어요. (표준, 강력, 쾌속, 내부세척 등등) 저는 성격이 급해서 쾌속도 써봤는데, 밥그릇 국그릇 정도는 괜찮지만 기름기 묻은 건 역시 표준 모드가 짱이더라구요.ㅎㅎ 그래서 99% 표준 모드만 사용해요! 이걸로도 충분히 말끔하게 닦여요.  아, 그리고 처음 구매해서 설치하면 동봉된 내부 세척용 세제를 넣고 내부 세척을 한 번 하고 난 뒤에 사용하시는 걸 추천드려요!  물론 미니 사이즈라서 커다란 냄비나 후라이팬은 안 들어가요ㅠ 작은 냄비(라면 1개 끓이는 정도?)는 가능한데, 큰 건 무리! 그래서 냄비나 후라이팬은 그냥 제가 직접 설거지를 해요ㅎㅎ 그래도 자잘자잘한 설거지거리가 싹 없어진 것만으로도 행복합니다.  기본이 무타공 설치지만, 옵션으로 타공해서 직수 연결도 가능하더라구요. (저는 해당 없음!ㅋㅋ) 요새 저 같은 1인가구가 엄청 많아졌잖아요. 내 집도 아닌데 타공하긴 어렵고, 큰 용량이 부담스러운 분들께 정말 강력 추천드려요!! 설거지 양 많지 않은 신혼부부나 딩크족분들께도 완전 추천!  진짜 편하고 좋아요. 기름기 완전 타파~~ 여러분들도 '미닉스 식기세척기' 이모님 들이시고 편한 생활하세요~~~

Sentence (English): The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!).
Comments (English): I live alone. It's the fate of living alone. Washing dishes. It's such a hassle, especially the grease that gets on plastic containers! I'm not the only one who hates washing dishes with a mixture of baking soda and detergent and hot water, right? It gets my hands hot and takes forever. This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.

This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.
Comments (Original): 저는 혼자 자취 중에 있는데요. 자취생의 숙명... 설거지... 정말 귀찮잖아요ㅠ 특히 플라스틱 용기에 묻은 기름기 같은 거요! 매번 베이킹소다랑 세제 섞어서 뜨거운 물로 닦는 거, 저만 싫은 거 아니죠? 손은 뜨겁고 시간은 오래 걸리고... 이 귀찮음에서 저를 해방시켜준 게 바로 이 미닉스 식기세척기입니다!!  정말 저희 집 주방이모 두 분 중 한 분으로 당당히 자리 잡았어요.ㅎㅎ  무엇보다 제가 전세 집이라 벽에 구멍을 뚫거나(타공) 시공하는 게 불가능했거든요. 그래서 설치가 간편한 무타공 제품을 찾았는데 이게 딱이더라구요! 그냥 전원 꼽고 물만 부어주면 되니까 저 같은 1인 가구 자취생이나 이사 자주 다니는 분들께는 이만한 게 없어요. 타공 걱정 없이 식세기를 쓸 수 있다니, 진짜 삶의 질이 달라졌어요.ㅎㅎ 말로만 좋다고 하면 안 믿으실까 봐ㅋㅋ 제가 세척력 테스트를 제대로 해봤어요. 평소에는 간단히 애벌 설거지를 하고 넣는데, 이번엔 리얼 후기를 위해 그냥 넣어봤습니다! (두근) 으... 돼지기름이랑 말라붙은 소스라니... 솔직히 굳은 머스타드는 잘 닦일까 살짝 걱정됐어요ㅋㅋㅋ  세제는 프로쉬 베이킹소다를 쓰는데요. 독일 제품이기도 하고, 기름기 제거에 아주 탁월해요.  저는 3인용 식기세척기라 타블렛을 미리 반으로 다 잘라놨어요. 요걸 그냥 바닥 아무데나 툭 던져주면 준비 끝! (별도 세제통이 없어서 더 편해요) 작년에 미닉스 전용 세제가 리뉴얼 중이라 이걸 사봤는데, 아직 한 박스나 남아서..ㅎㅎ 다 쓰면 리뉴얼된 미닉스 세제도 써보려구요!  사용법도 진짜 간단해요. 먼저 전원플러그 꼽고 전원을 켜면, 디스플레이 우측 버튼으로 모드를 선택할 수 있어요. (표준, 강력, 쾌속, 내부세척 등등) 저는 성격이 급해서 쾌속도 써봤는데, 밥그릇 국그릇 정도는 괜찮지만 기름기 묻은 건 역시 표준 모드가 짱이더라구요.ㅎㅎ 그래서 99% 표준 모드만 사용해요! 이걸로도 충분히 말끔하게 닦여요.  아, 그리고 처음 구매해서 설치하면 동봉된 내부 세척용 세제를 넣고 내부 세척을 한 번 하고 난 뒤에 사용하시는 걸 추천드려요!  물론 미니 사이즈라서 커다란 냄비나 후라이팬은 안 들어가요ㅠ 작은 냄비(라면 1개 끓이는 정도?)는 가능한데, 큰 건 무리! 그래서 냄비나 후라이팬은 그냥 제가 직접 설거지를 해요ㅎㅎ 그래도 자잘자잘한 설거지거리가 싹 없어진 것만으로도 행복합니다.  기본이 무타공 설치지만, 옵션으로 타공해서 직수 연결도 가능하더라구요. (저는 해당 없음!ㅋㅋ) 요새 저 같은 1인가구가 엄청 많아졌잖아요. 내 집도 아닌데 타공하긴 어렵고, 큰 용량이 부담스러운 분들께 정말 강력 추천드려요!! 설거지 양 많지 않은 신혼부부나 딩크족분들께도 완전 추천!  진짜 편하고 좋아요. 기름기 완전 타파~~ 여러분들도 '미닉스 식기세척기' 이모님 들이시고 편한 생활하세요~~~

Sentence (English): It's so convenient and great.
Comments (English): I live alone. It's the fate of living alone. Washing dishes. It's such a hassle, especially the grease that gets on plastic containers! I'm not the only one who hates washing dishes with a mixture of baking soda and detergent and hot water, right? It gets my hands hot and takes forever. This Minix dishwasher has freed me from this hassle! It's truly become one of the two kitchen assistants in my house. More importantly, since I'm renting, drilling holes in the walls (perforation) or installing anything else isn't possible. So, I looked for a no-drills, easy-to-install dishwasher, and this was perfect! Just plug it in and pour in water. For single-person households like me or those who move frequently, this is the perfect solution. Being able to use the dishwasher without worrying about drilling holes has truly changed my quality of life. I didn't want to believe it just because it was good, so I did a thorough cleaning test. I usually just do a quick pre-wash before loading, but this time, I just put it in for a real review! (Thumping) Ugh. Lard and dried sauce? Honestly, I was a little worried about whether the hardened mustard would come off well. I use Frosch baking soda detergent. It's a German product and excellent at removing grease. Since I have a three-person dishwasher, I cut the tablets in half beforehand. Just toss them anywhere on the floor and you're ready to go! (It's even more convenient because there's no separate detergent container.) Last year, the Minix detergent was being renewed, so I bought that, and I still have a box left. I'm going to try the renewed Minix detergent once I run out! It's really simple to use. First, plug in the power cord and turn it on. You can select the mode using the button on the right side of the display (Standard, Intensive, Quick, Interior Clean, etc.). I'm impatient, so I tried the Quick mode, and it's fine for rice bowls and soup bowls, but for grease, the Standard mode is the best. That's why I only use the Standard mode 99% of the time! This one gets the job done perfectly. Oh, and when you first purchase and install it, I recommend using the included internal cleaning detergent and cleaning the interior first before using it! Of course, it's mini-sized, so large pots or frying pans won't fit. Small pots (one enough to boil ramen?) are fine, but anything large is out of the question! So I just wash the pots and pans myself. Still, I'm happy just knowing there's no more mess to clean. The default is a non-drilled installation, but you can also drill a hole for a direct water connection (not for me!). These days, there are so many single-person households like mine. Drilling holes in a place that's not yours, and for those who find large capacity burdensome, I highly recommend it! I also highly recommend it for newlyweds and DINKs who don't do a lot of dishes! It's so convenient and great. It completely eliminates grease. Everyone, bring in your Minix dishwasher aunts and live a comfortable life.

Comments (English): [ You can escape from housework after work! ] || ---------------- || Review of the MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person *I received this product as part of the Coupang Trial Team* Dishes are the most tedious and tiring chore in the house. Especially when you're making baby food and washing baby items, it feels like you're standing at the sink for a whole day and a half. The MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person I recently tried felt like a real escape from that wrist-straining hell. It's not for nothing that it's so highly rated. Installation is ZERO difficult. One of the biggest advantages of this product is its no-drills design. Simply connect the water line and it's ready to use. Even those who don't live in their own homes can use it without any hassle. There are no kitchen restrictions. Just open the product, add the dishes, add the detergent, and you're done! This is truly revolutionary. I'm so happy that I was able to set it up in no time at all, even without my husband's help. I thought it would be small because it's a 3-person unit, but it's surprisingly spacious. It can hold plates, cups, a child's folding plate, soup bowls, and even a small pot lid. Even in a small kitchen, it does its job well. Especially since I have a lot of baby bottles and baby food containers, this small unit holds quite a bit of storage. Cleaning power? It's a hoot. It thoroughly washes greasy plates, baby items, and even cups with water stains. Hot water and a powerful jet of water leave no residue behind. Before using it, I worried its small size might lack cleaning power, but my worries were unfounded. It even dries, so it's ready to use right away. For oily stains, just turn it on the power mode. Water saving + time saving = benefit. Washing dishes by hand always uses a lot of water, but this is truly economical. Just add water and turn it on, and you'll notice a significant reduction in water usage. Best of all, eliminating the need for dishwashing means you can take a moment to stretch and breathe after putting the baby to sleep. Hygiene is also a plus. The high-heat wash ensures a strong sterilizing effect. This is crucial for families with children. It's like having a separate bottle sterilizer. It eliminates grease odors and even plastic container odors. Clean design + low noise. The simple gray tone blends well with any kitchen. The matte finish doesn't look cheap, giving it a sophisticated feel. The noise level during washing is surprisingly low. I even used it at night without waking my child. --- Overall Review: The Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is a product that has it all: easy installation, cleaning power, space utilization, and design. I highly recommend it to families with children, dual-income couples, and those with small studio kitchens. It's a practical essential that significantly reduces dishwashing stress. For those who want to protect their wrists, save time, and maintain hygiene, this is a cost-effective product that's hard to beat. The more you use it, the more satisfied you become. If you're hesitating, just get it. A life free from dishwashing is sweeter than you think.

For those who want to protect their wrists, save time, and maintain hygiene, this is a cost-effective product that's hard to beat. The more you use it, the more satisfied you become. If you're hesitating, just get it. A life free from dishwashing is sweeter than you think.

Sentence (English): So far I have been very pleased with the Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ (Mostly) A Really Good and Quiet Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || So far I have been very pleased with the Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher. I usually use the 60-minute wash and have not had any issues with dishes not coming out clean, although I typically rinse all dishes well before placing in the dishwasher. I really like the utensil rack on the top rack and appreciate that there is still a small utensil holder on the bottom rack for larger utensils. This dishwasher also has room for a lot of dishes, it just took me a few times to figure out the best way to utilize the space. This dishwasher is very quiet and you can see a red light on the floor indicating it is running. I rated this four stars for a few reasons. The racks don't feel as sturdy and roll in and out as well as I would expect from an expensive dishwasher, which gives me some concern for the longevity of the racks, only time will tell. I also have some issues with the design of the middle rack (used for glasses and cups). The right side row is very narrow between the tines and the side wall, only the thinnest glasses fit on that row. The shelves on this rack are more of a hindrance than useful. The slots on the shelf for wine glasses can't be used, they are so shallow that wine glasses tip forward rather than resting safely back in the slot. I removed one of the two shelves, thinking that I could still use the other shelf to place small bowls or lids on, but I will probably also remove that one because it is very difficult to stack anything under it, in front of it, or even next to it. The shelf doesn't flip up so you can't easily put things under it and then secure it in place. It does flip down, but the row is so narrow that virtually nothing fits well in front of it. On a positive note, the middle shelf does have a wide middle section where you can stack bowls, cups or whatever. It is very versatile. Overall I can work with those small issues and I would recommend this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): If you think a compact dishwasher means compromising, this Bosch will put you to shame.
Comments (English): [ A true champion in a small format! ] || ---------------- || If you think a compact dishwasher means compromising, this Bosch will put you to shame. Seriously, if you live alone, with your significant other, or simply don't have space for a "cupboard," this is your man. Here's why it's so good: 1. It washes like a pro. There's no "but it's small, it should just rinse." This miracle cleans! Forget about soaking. Even that dried-on plate from last night's ketchup or egg - you run it and it comes out shiny. ActiveWater technology sprays the water super smartly, so everything goes great. 2. It's as quiet as a ninja It has an EcoSilence motor, which in human language means: "Hey, did I run it?". It's 49 dB - that's quieter than a normal conversation. It's ideal if your kitchen is next to the living room (or in the living room) and you don't want to shout over the roar of the dishwasher while watching a series. 3. The magic of "ExtraDry" The most annoying thing? To take out wet dishes. There is one button here – ExtraDry – you press it and forget it. It “sears” them a little longer and harder at the end and everything, even the dull plastic boxes, comes out dry. 4. It has everything It is not cut out for extras. It has: * Automatic program (itself judges how dirty it is). * Cup program (so that they don’t become “cobwebs”). * HygienePlus: Kills bacteria with boiling water (70°C). It’s great if you have a baby or you’re just afraid of germs. * VarioSpeed: When you’re in a hurry and don’t have clean plates for dinner. 5. It looks brutal With that black glass on the front, it’s very elegant. It’s not just a “white box”, it’s a jewel for the countertop. Plus, it has AquaStop – which means you won’t come home and find a flood at the neighbors below. In the end: If you don’t have space, but you hate washing by hand and want something that really works – get it. It's expensive, yes, but it's a Bosch Series 6 and worth every penny. A true A-lister!
Comments (Original): [ Истински шампион в малък формат! ] || ---------------- || Ако си мислиш, че компактна съдомиялна означава да правиш компромис, тази Bosch-ка ще те накара да се засрамиш. Сериозно, ако живееш сам, с половинката или просто нямаш място за 'шкаф', това е твоят човек.Ето защо е толкова добра:1. Мие като за световноНяма 'ама тя е малка, сигурно само плакне'. Това чудо чисти! Забрави за кисненето. Дори онази засъхнала чиния от снощния кетчуп или яйце – пускаш я и излиза блестяща. Технологията ActiveWater пръска водата супер умно, така че всичко става топ.2. Тиха е като нинджаИма EcoSilence мотор, което на човешки език означава: 'Абе, пуснах ли я?'. На 49 dB е – това е по-тихо от нормален разговор. Идеална е, ако кухнята ти е до хола (или в хола) и не искаш да надвикваш рева на съдомиялна, докато гледаш сериал.3. Магията 'ExtraDry'Най-дразнещото нещо? Да вадиш мокри съдове. Тук има един бутон – ExtraDry – натискаш го и забравяш. Той ги 'запича' малко по-дълго и по-силно накрая и всичко, дори тъпите пластмасови кутии, излизат сухи.4. Има си всичкоНе е орязана откъм екстри. Има си: * Автоматична програма (сама си преценява колко е мръсно). * Програма за чаши (за да не станат на 'паяжина'). * HygienePlus: Убива бактериите с вряла вода (70°C). Супер е, ако имаш бебе или просто те е страх от микроби. * VarioSpeed: Като бързаш, а нямаш чисти чинии за вечеря.5. Изглежда бруталноСъс това черно стъкло отпред е страшно елегантна. Не е просто 'бяла кутия', а си е бижу за плота. Плюс това има AquaStop – което значи, че няма да се прибереш и да завариш потоп у съседите отдолу.На финала:Ако нямаш място, но мразиш да миеш на ръка и искаш нещо, което наистина работи – взимай я. Скъпа е, да, но е Bosch Серия 6 и си струва всяка стотинка. Истински отличник!

I have never bought a piece of appliance that did not come with a way to plug it into the wall (including a dishwasher by Bosch, which absolutely came with EVERYTHING I needed to get it installed). Samsung goes out of their way to sell you extended warranty and other unnecessary services and leaves out the most critical thing, which is the ability to get it installed when it arrives. Besides the power cable, it also does not come with a 90-degree adapter that's required to hook it up to the water line. I find these omissions to be dishonest and I wish I had bought another Bosch or at least ordered this from Costco instead, because Costco does include the basic installation parts. I tried contacting Samsung to give them a chance to remedy the situation, but they jerked me around for two weeks and eventually just stopped responding to me. It cleans much better than my old dishwasher, is more efficient and everything comes out very dry, even though there isn't a heated dry (for efficiency reasons). The rack is really sturdy and the pull out rails are strong and not wobbly. The one issue I noticed is that when you load the bottom tray with more weight in the front than the back the rack drops down between the main part of the dishwasher and the door because there is a gap for it to drop. It's not a big deal, just start loading from the back forward and this won't happen. Not a real problem, just an observation. Since it is a top control and you can't see the controls once you close the door, there is a really cool red light that shines on the floor to tell you when it is running. It's a good thing since it is so quiet that it's hard to know if it is running or not. Once the dishes are cleaned and have had enough time to dry, the light turns off to indicate it is finished. A really nicely thought out feature! All of that being said, the very best feature of this dishwasher is a third rack on the very top for all of the utensils. With the design of it, the utensils get put into a rack that keeps them separated so they get really clean because they aren't touching each other. You can even sort them in the rack for quicker unloading. This feature also gives you more room on the bottom rack since you don't need the utensil holder there. They do provide a utensil holder that can be used on the bottom rack as well. I am not sure why because the top rack holds more than enough. I just put it away since I had no reason to use it so far. I would highly recommend this product and it sure makes me want to consider Bosch appliances for my kitchen remodel.

You can even sort them in the rack for quicker unloading. This feature also gives you more room on the bottom rack since you don’t need the utensil holder there. They do provide a utensil holder that can be used on the bottom rack as well. I am not sure why because the top rack holds more than enough. I just put it away since I had no reason to use it so far. I would highly recommend this product and it sure makes me want to consider Bosch appliances for my kitchen remodel.

Comments (English): [ Racks not as good as the older 4000 model. ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher to replace a 15 year old model 4000 Whirlpool. We had to replace our old one because the door latch assembly broke and the replacement parts were not available. This new model is more quiet and perhaps more water efficient.HOWEvER. the racks in this new model are not well designed for large shallow bowls. The old model had pegs the right size to hole a shallow bowl upright, so you could load several to be washed at the same time.This new model has pegs that are too far apart, so the bowls lean over, almost flat and block each other.The could be put on the second rack face down, but only about three would fit. and there would be no place for cups.The drying is not as efficient and the older unit, and if you forget to "turn off" the Door dry option, (that unlocks the door and opens it a bit at the end of a cycle), your dishes and the inside of the dishwasher will be wet. (even with Jet Dry added). Overall, the unit is quiet and efficient, but will not allow the same number of dishes, (mainly shallow bowls), to be loaded as the older unit.

P.S. cleaning & maintenance got a good score along with noise because the machine is purely decorative & of no use, like an expensive rock!

Sentence (English): We've had the dishwasher for about a week, and so far so good.
Comments (English): [ So far so good! ] || ---------------- || We've had the dishwasher for about a week, and so far so good. The only slightly bothersome thing is that the third rack is just barely too short for many of our bowls and mugs, which tend to rub on the rubber gasket at the top of the dishwasher door when we slide the rack in and out. It would be nice to be able to adjust the third rack height to avoid this. Other than that, the dishwasher is working great. Cleans well. It makes a little more noise than our previous Whirlpool, probably because of the chopper, but we run it at night anyway. I like that it pops open the door for air drying at the end of the cycle. Also, we like that it has a drip tray at the front to catch and sense leaks. Our previous dishwasher had a leak at the front, which caused a lot of water damage in our kitchen, which is why we got a new one. We've installed additional water leak sensors now too.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher to replace a 15 year old model 4000 Whirlpool.
Comments (English): [ Racks not as good as the older 4000 model. ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher to replace a 15 year old model 4000 Whirlpool. We had to replace our old one because the door latch assembly broke and the replacement parts were not available. This new model is more quiet and perhaps more water efficient. HOWEvER. the racks in this new model are not well designed for large shallow bowls. The old model had pegs the right size to hole a shallow bowl upright, so you could load several to be washed at the same time. This new model has pegs that are too far apart, so the bowls lean over, almost flat and block each other. The could be put on the second rack face down, but only about three would fit. and there would be no place for cups. The drying is not as efficient and the older unit, and if you forget to "turn off" the Door dry option, (that unlocks the door and opens it a bit at the end of a cycle), your dishes and the inside of the dishwasher will be wet. (even with Jet Dry added). Overall, the unit is quiet and efficient, but will not allow the same number of dishes, (mainly shallow bowls), to be loaded as the older unit.

Comments (English): After getting a dishwasher while raising twins, three things have definitely changed: 1. Hygiene & Safety. The steam and high-temperature sterilization functions are a comfort when washing baby dishes. Official information emphasizes that 100% steam can kill harmful bacteria. This means I no longer have to worry about moisture or grease left behind after washing. 2. Volume and Time Savings. With four people plus baby dishes, snack bowls, and pots, doing all the dishes by hand was a burden, but this dishwasher is efficient because it can handle a lot at once. With less time spent washing dishes, it feels like we've spent more time together as a family. 3. Organizing and Drying. The door opens automatically and the hot air dryer function means there's rarely any water pooling at the bottom of the dishes when I take them out. And because the dishes are already dry, they're ready to use when I'm preparing the baby's dishes.

There's no cutlery rack, and the dishwasher has to be laid out on the first shelf (Samsung seems to have the same layout), which takes more time and is cumbersome. Because it's placed on a single shelf, the second and third shelves are relatively low, so I have to bend over more to put in the dishes, which hurts my back. 2. It takes too long to dry. The plate holder is flat, and it seems like you have to use the drying function to dry them. The upsides are that it's quieter and the voice assistant provides helpful guidance. I wonder if my rating will go up once I get used to it.
Comments (Original): SK식세기를 쓰다가 고장이 나서 엘지로 바꿨어요. 일주일 사용 후기입니다. 12인용 sk와 비교했을 때 아쉬운 점은 1. 수저통이 없고 1단 칸에 펼쳐 두게 한 것이(삼성도 같은 구성인듯) 시간도 더 걸리고 번거롭네요. 1칸으로 배치해서 2단 3단 칸이 상대적으로 낮게 배치되어 접시 넣을 때 더 숙여야 하니 허리가 아파요. 2. 물기 마르는 시간이 너무 오래 걸려요. 접시 꽂는 구조도 ---자로 평평한데다 건조 기능을 사용해야만 말려지나봐요. 장점은 소음이 적다는거, 음성 지원이 되어 친절히 안내해 주는거요. 익숙해지면 별점이 상향되려나 모르겠네요.ㅎ

Sentence (English): This time, I got to try out the Minix Mini PRO 3-Person Dishwasher through the Coupang Experience Team.
Comments (English): [ Small but powerful! Mini dishes are a must-have for one- to two-person households. ] || ---------------- || This time, I got to try out the Minix Mini PRO 3-Person Dishwasher through the Coupang Experience Team. Living alone, I never really thought I needed a dishwasher, but after using it, I realized how much easier it has become. From the moment I unboxed it, I was impressed by its compact yet sophisticated design, which didn't detract from my kitchen decor. The white body, with its clean LED panel, made it simple to use. Installation was surprisingly straightforward. Just follow the instructions to connect the water supply hose and secure the drain hose to the sink. It was ready to use right away, requiring no plumbing, so I was able to set it up myself. Initially, I was concerned about the water usage, but after actually using it, I noticed it used significantly less water than washing dishes by hand. The real test of use was after dinner, when I loaded it with three plates, two cups, spoons, and a frying pan. I was skeptical about its compact size, but the results were astonishing. It cleaned even greasy dishes sparkling clean! Even the old stains on the frying pan were completely removed. When I opened the door after washing, the dishes were fluffy and dry, with a blast of hot steam. Not a single water stain was left. The drying function was more powerful than I expected, so I didn't need to wipe them down. I especially liked the variety of modes available, allowing me to choose based on the condition of my dishes. Eco mode was sufficient for everyday use, and on oily days, a strong wash ensured a perfect clean. It wasn't too noisy, so I didn't have to worry about running it late at night. The stainless steel interior also reduces bacteria growth, and cleaning was a breeze. Simply remove the filter and rinse it out, making maintenance a breeze. Best of all, I only need to run it once or twice a day, and the stress of washing dishes is completely gone! Washing dishes by hand used to chapped hands and waste a lot of water, but now I can just put it in the machine and press a button. I was worried about the electricity bill, so I checked it after using it for a few days, and it was surprisingly less taxing. The Minix PRO model is energy-efficient, so I didn't notice a significant difference even with frequent runs. While this product is rated for "three people," it's actually perfect for one or two-person households. As someone who lives alone, it was perfect for handling a day's worth of dishes at once, and it's compact enough to fit next to the sink or on the dining table without taking up much space. Overall, the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is a great choice for small kitchens, offering powerful cleaning power and convenience. Eliminating the stress of hand-washing has transformed my quality of life. I'm so happy that I was able to try such a great product thanks to the Coupang Experience Group. Now, I'm recommending it to my friends, saying, "This is a must-have!"
Comments (Original): [ 작지만 강력한 세척력! 1~2인 가구 필수템 미니 식기 ] || ---------------- || 이번에 쿠팡체험단을 통해 미닉스 미니 식기세척기 PRO 3인용을 사용해보게 되었어요. 평소 혼자 살다 보니 식기세척기까지는 필요 없다고 생각했는데, 막상 사용해보니 “왜 이제야 써봤을까” 싶을 정도로 생활이 편해졌습니다. 처음 언박싱할 때부터 제품이 꽤 컴팩트하면서도 고급스러운 디자인이라 주방 인테리어를 해치지 않았어요. 흰색 본체에 깔끔한 LED 패널이 있어서 조작도 간단했습니다.  설치는 생각보다 간단했어요. 설명서에 따라 급수 호스를 연결하고, 배수 호스만 싱크대에 고정해두면 끝! 따로 수도공사 필요 없이 바로 사용할 수 있어서 혼자서도 충분히 세팅 가능했어요. 처음엔 물 사용량이 궁금했는데, 실제로 돌려보니 직접 손 설거지할 때보다 물이 훨씬 적게 들어간다는 걸 느꼈어요.  본격적으로 사용해본 건 저녁 식사 후, 접시 3개와 컵 2개, 수저, 프라이팬 하나를 넣었을 때였어요. “이 작은 크기에 제대로 닦일까?” 의심했는데, 결과는 놀라웠어요. 기름기 가득한 그릇도 번쩍번쩍하게 깨끗하게 세척! 프라이팬의 묵은 얼룩까지 깔끔하게 제거됐습니다. 세척 후 문을 열었을 때 뜨거운 김과 함께 그릇들이 뽀송뽀송하게 말라 있어서, 물자국 하나 없었어요. 건조 기능이 생각보다 강력해서 따로 닦을 필요가 없더라고요.  특히 마음에 들었던 점은 다양한 모드가 있어서 식기 상태에 따라 선택할 수 있었어요. 평소에는 에코 모드로 충분하고, 기름기 많은 날에는 강세척으로 돌리면 완벽하게 세척됩니다. 소음도 크지 않아서 밤 늦게 돌려도 신경 쓰이지 않았어요.  또한 내부가 스테인리스 재질이라 세균 번식 걱정이 덜 되고, 청소도 간단했어요. 필터를 꺼내서 헹구기만 하면 되니 관리도 쉬워요. 무엇보다 마음에 드는 건, 하루에 한두 번만 돌리면 설거지 스트레스가 완전히 사라진다는 점! 손 설거지를 할 때마다 손이 트거나 물 낭비가 심했는데, 이제는 그냥 기계에 넣고 버튼 한 번만 누르면 끝이니까요.  전기요금이 걱정돼서 며칠간 사용 후 전기세도 체크해봤는데, 생각보다 부담스럽지 않았어요. 미닉스 PRO 모델은 전력 효율이 좋아서 자주 돌려도 큰 차이가 없더라고요.  이 제품의 크기는 ‘3인용’이지만, 실제로는 1~2인 가구에서 쓰기에 딱이에요. 혼자 사는 저로서는 하루치 식기를 한 번에 처리하기 딱 좋았고, 부피가 크지 않아 싱크대 옆이나 식탁 위에 올려둬도 공간 차지가 거의 없어요.  총평하자면, 미닉스 미니 식기세척기 PRO 3인용은 작은 주방에도 잘 어울리고, 강력한 세척력과 편리함을 모두 갖춘 최고의 미니 식기세척기입니다. 손 설거지 스트레스가 사라지니 삶의 질이 달라졌어요. 쿠팡체험단 덕분에 이런 좋은 제품을 써볼 수 있어서 정말 만족스러웠습니다. 지금은 친구들에게도 “이건 진짜 사야 돼!”라고 강력 추천하고 있어요.

Would be better on top of door or back-lit when you open the door. If you have the 2nd tray high enough for the top sprayer to clear dinner plates in the bottom tray, you have to stack salad plates at an angle in the top rack or they won't clear the 3rd tray.

Sentence (English): I bought a Bosch SMH4EVX08E dishwasher and I have to say that I am very happy with it so far.
Comments (English): [ Bosch SMH4EVX08E Series 4 ] || ---------------- || I bought a Bosch SMH4EVX08E dishwasher and I have to say that I am very happy with it so far. It is a built-in model from the 4 series, so it is a golden mean – neither the cheapest nor the most expensive. The main thing that surprised me is how quiet it is. With the previous dishwasher, we preferred not to run it in the evening because it made a noise like an old vacuum cleaner. This one is 44 dB and you hardly know it – we can watch a movie and the dishwasher runs next door in the kitchen without disturbing it. As for the quality of the washing, no reservations so far. The dishes are always clean, even if I throw a burnt pot or plates of baked pasta in there. I really like the EfficientDry function – after the program ends, the dishwasher opens itself a little and the dishes are completely dry after a while, even plastic boxes that the old dishwasher never dried properly. The internal layout is super well thought out in my opinion. The upper basket is height-adjustable, so if I have large glasses or a tall pot, I can simply move it. And the third drawer at the top for cutlery is great – I feel much better with it than with a classic basket. The dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes (14 place settings), which will be especially appreciated by larger households. I also tried the connection via Home Connect. Honestly, I didn't expect to use it, but it ended up being quite nice – for example, when we're leaving, I start it via my mobile phone. The app also shows how much time is left. The energy class is B, which isn't exactly top-notch, but considering how much it can handle and how quietly it runs, I don't mind it. Water consumption of around 9 l per cycle is excellent. Assembly was easy, Bosch has good instructions for this and the vario hinges (door adjustment hinges) work exactly as they should - the door opens smoothly and nothing rubs anywhere. Pros: ✅ Quiet, powerful and saves water ✅ Washes and dries perfectly, including plastics ✅ Lots of space and flexible layout ✅ Automatic door opening after washing ✅ Mobile control works without problems It is a reliable dishwasher that feels sturdy, quiet, with good programs and results. After a long time, an appliance that simply works as it should.
Comments (Original): [ Bosch SMH4EVX08E Serie 4 ] || ---------------- || Pořídil jsem myčku Bosch SMH4EVX08E a musím říct, že jsem s ní zatím hodně spokojený. Je to vestavný model ze série 4, takže takový zlatý střed – ani nejlevnější, ani přehnaně drahý.Hlavní věc, která mě překvapila, je tichý chod. U předchozí myčky jsme ji večer radši nespouštěli, protože hučela jak starý vysavač. Tahle má 44 dB a fakt o ní skoro nevíte – můžeme koukat na film a myčka běží vedle v kuchyni, aniž by rušila.Co se týče kvality mytí, zatím bez výhrad. Nádobí je vždycky čisté, i když tam hodím připálený hrnec nebo talíře od zapečených těstovin.Hodně se mi líbí funkce EfficientDry – po skončení programu se myčka sama pootevře a nádobí je po chvíli úplně suché, dokonce i plastové krabičky, které stará myčka nikdy pořádně nevysušila.Vnitřní uspořádání je za mě super promyšlené. Horní koš se dá výškově nastavit, takže když mám velké sklenice nebo vysoký hrnec, jednoduše ho posunu. A třetí zásuvka nahoře na příbory je paráda – mám z ní mnohem lepší pocit než z klasického košíku.Do myčky se vejde hodně nádobí (14 sad), což ocení hlavně větší domácnosti.Zkusil jsem i připojení přes Home Connect. Upřímně, nečekal jsem, že to budu používat, ale nakonec je to docela fajn – třeba když odjíždíme, spustím ji přes mobil. Aplikace ukazuje i kolik zbývá času.Energetická třída je B, což není úplný top, ale vzhledem k tomu, kolik zvládne a jak tiše běží, mi to nevadí. Spotřeba vody kolem 9 l na cyklus je výborná.Montáž byla jednoduchá, Bosch má k tomu dobrý návod a variopanty (panty na přizpůsobení dvířek) fungují přesně, jak mají – dvířka se otevírají hladce a nikde nic nedrhne.Plusy:✅ Tichá, výkonná a šetří vodu✅ Skvěle myje i suší, včetně plastů✅ Hodně prostoru a flexibilní uspořádání✅ Automatické otevření dveří po mytí✅ Ovládání přes mobil funguje bez problémůJe to spolehlivá myčka, která působí bytelně, tichá, s dobrými programy a výsledky. Po dlouhé době spotřebič, který prostě funguje tak, jak má.
