Sentence (English): We have been using Bosch dishwashers for years and are completely satisfied.
Comments (English): [ Reliable household helper ] || ---------------- || We have been using Bosch dishwashers for years and are completely satisfied. The latest model would certainly have served for years, but unfortunately it suffered irreversible damage to the door after an unfortunate attack by children. This model was new to us. We considered the Series 2 dishwasher, but in the end we chose this one, especially because of the automatic door rebound function after the end of the washing program - a function that we really missed in the last model. Our biggest concerns were the absence of a dish rack and its replacement with an upper drawer. In the end, however, we like the new way of folding cutlery, especially because there is now noticeably more space for larger dishes in the lower drawer. We kept the cutlery rack from the original dishwasher to be on the safe side - this is surprisingly still compatible with the new model despite the age of our old dishwasher. However, we have not used it yet and perhaps we kept it unnecessarily. As for the quality of washing, we have no reservations. Bosch did not disappoint in this regard.
Comments (Original): [ Spolehlivý pomocník v domácnosti ] || ---------------- || Myčky značky Bosch používáme již léta a jsme naprosto spokojeni. Poslední model by jistě ještě roky sloužil, ale bohužel utrpěl nevratné poškození dvířek po nešťastném útoku dětí.Tento model pro nás byl novinkou. Zvažovali jsme myčku Serie 2, ale nakonec padla volba na tuto a to zejména kvůli funkci automatického odskoku dvířek po ukončení mycího programu - funkce, jež nám velmi chyběla u posledního modelu.Největší obavy jsme měli kvůli absenci koše na nádobí a jeho náhradě horním šuplíkem. Nakonec nám ale nový způsob skládání příborů vyhovuje, zejména díky tomu, že v dolním šuplíku je nyní znatelně více prostoru na větší nádobí. Koš na příbory jsme pro jistotu ponechali z původní myčky - tento je kupodivu i přes stáří naší staré myčky stále kompatibilní s novým modelem. Ještě jsme jej ale nepoužili a možná jsme si jej nechávali zbytečně.Co se týče kvality mytí, nemáme výhrad. Bosch v tomto nezklamala.

Sentence (English): We bought the LDNF34321 in 2023.
Comments (English): [ Flickering lights and moisture issues ] || ---------------- || We bought the LDNF34321 in 2023. However in the past 4 months we've been having issues with the lights flickering/frizzing in the middle of a cycle or randomly after the wash ends. Nothing will stop it until we unplug it. Now it will not even start - when plugged the number 8 starts flickering crazily and nothing happens. Repairing is not easy - quote is $545 to replace the control panel. Apparently this model ( and it looks like the 34321t also) is notorious for having issues with moisture getting into the area housing the pc board. In fact, the first two repair companies I called declined to take on the job as soon as I said it is an LG with this model number. We are now trying to decide whether to fix (and risking this happening again) or replace with something completely different. Looking online one can see this is a very common issue, with some people trying to fix it themselves and emphasizing the need to add sealant etc. in order to avoid this happening again. I urge the company to address this problem as soon as possible. This is unacceptable.

Sentence (English): We had a previous dishwasher for eight years and it finally gave out.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, sleek, little ] || ---------------- || We had a previous dishwasher for eight years and it finally gave out. We wanted to go the high quality route and had heard alot about Bosch. The install was super easy (as far as installing dishwashers go). I really like the buttons as they are more touch sensitive instead of the cheap plastic ones I've seen on my dishwashers lately. I like the remote function, although not something I use often. It really is pretty quiet. I'm not wild about the "auto dry" feature where is pops open at the end of the cycle, but it works as intended and probably saves some money. There seems to be really random steps to start a cycle manually and it beeps at you if you don't press it down twice before closing it for the the cycle. Even though there's no response on the second press. Lastly the biggest pain point is just the size. It feels like a pretty big chore for anything to fit in that tiny bottom shelf with out the bottom spinner hitting something. I like the wine glass holders. Those are handy. Overall I'm satisfied, just wish I was more satisfied for the cost. I hope it lasts more than eight years. The app is really well designed too.

Only criticism is that the racks don't have a lot of flexibility for large bowls (soup and cereal) and other odd items. There also is not a third rack for flatware, but the clearance on the bottom rack is so large (if the top rack is in the upmost position) that I can put large spoons, spatulas, and utensils upright in the silverware basket. Also, I actually prefer to see the controls and time to completion in action on the front of the dishwasher as opposed to hidden (at the top of the door) when it's running. Highly recommended for an economical dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ A Big Letdown From A Longtime Bosch Owner ] || ---------------- || This is the 3rd Bosch dishwasher that I've owned in the last 20 years. The first two I loved. Rock solid, really well built, quiet, reliable, with easy to use controls.Sadly, this one has almost none of those qualities.First off, the build quality is REALLY poor. Everything inside the dishwasher is made of *really* embarrassingly thin plastic. The trays are small and very flimsy. I tried to adjust a tray and stopped because it felt like it would just snap in my hands.The controls are also a big step back. While there are most of the options you could want, why is there no indicator that the cycle has completed, and the dishes are clean? That's a huge omission to me! More than once I've gone to the dishwasher, not remembering whether I ran the cycle or not, opened it up, things looked clean, and started taking out dishes only to see that it clearly hadn't run yet. Yuck.And finally, in terms of performance, it does clean the dishes pretty well, I have no issue with that so far, except that it leaves them pretty wet when the cycle ends. There is an option to dry it more, but it's ineffective. Even selecting that option, the dishes come out, let's call it "damp".I definitely regret getting this dishwasher. Bosch has let me down.

Sentence (English): A dishwasher was one of the must-buy items when moving.
Comments (English): [ Improving quality of life~ ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher was one of the must-buy items when moving. I made sure to find a spot for it while decorating, and after purchasing it in advance, I set a date and had it installed on the desired date. The installer did a great job and explained everything well, so I'm enjoying it. I eat a light breakfast, wash the dishes, and then run lunch and dinner together. Dinner is late, so by the time I run it after 8, it's almost 10. ^^;; I've seen many reviews saying it's not too noisy, but since I'm a first-time dishwasher user, I'm not sure if it's really that quiet. Since I run it late at night, it's quiet, and if I pay attention, I can hear the washing machine, which is to be expected. Does the high-temperature drying function work? I've heard it's not, but if you set it to high, the door will heat up when it opens automatically. I just rinsed the dishes, and in the morning, they're all clean and squeaky clean. I'm still not very good at Dish Tetris, but I'm sure I'll improve. I even got a credit card discount and a first-class rebate, so I think I got a good deal. I'm satisfied. ^^
Comments (Original): [ 삶의 질 향상~ ] || ---------------- || 이사하면서 식세기는 꼭 구입해야지 하는 품목 중 하나였어요. 인테리어하면서 식세기 자리 마련해놨고, 미리 구입후 날짜 지정해서  원하는 날짜에 설치했어요~ 기사님이 잘 설치해주셨고, 설명도 잘해주셔서 잘쓰고 있어요. 아침은 간단하게 먹어서 설거지하고 점심,저녁 모아서 한번 돌리는데 저녁시간이 늦어서 8시넘어서 돌리면 거의 10시 넘어가는 상황^^;; 소음이 크지않다는 후기를 많이 봤는데 식세기를 처음 쓰는 입장이라 이정도는 조용한건지 잘모르겠네요ㅎ 저녁 늦게돌리니 조용한 상태에서 신경쓰면 세척하는 소리가 들리는데 그건 당연하겠죠ㅎ  고온건조는 고온은? 아니라고 들었는데 설정해두면 자동문열림시 열기가 있어요~  애벌설거지?그냥 물만 헹구는 정도로 넣고 아침에보면 뽀득뽀득 잘 닦겨있어요. 아직 그릇 테트리스를 잘 못하지만 점점 실력?이  늘어나겠죠ㅎ  카드할인까지 받고, 1등급 환급 받으니 그래도 저렴하게 구입한거 같아요~ 만족합니다~^^

Sentence (English): Our baseline haier dishwasher hdw100wct sprung a leak after 13 years.
Comments (English): Our baseline haier dishwasher hdw100wct sprung a leak after 13 years.Hummed and hawed over replacement in the $900 to $1200 range and all were a compromise.Stumbled on the HDW15F4S1 on sale $1999 down to $1457. But wait - it also has a $200 cashback. So it fitted on price. A wee bit fiddly to install as they now have included a hose that cannot be detached from the dishwasher and has a large anti flood device that must pass through the relevant holes.Took a bit of time, but we did get a confirmation that the washer could be attached to the household hot water tank.Whats in it? Good updated prongy bits that can be folded down to suit and a much nicer set of glassware holdersA cutlery basket that can fit anywhere but is a bit cumbersome.The hallowed draw at the top for cutlery.The filter is easy to remove and lock back.Heaps of different wash programmes.Connects to Haiers smart app. And yes it will open the door when the cycle is finishedThe compromise.We always rinse out dishes and normally use the fastest programme. Our old one would wash in about 15 minutes. This new washer takes some 4 hours on ECO! THe next fastest take 60 minutes.Like the Samsung washing machine the dishwasher manual wont say how many pre wash and rinses go on with the programmes. Information is sparse siting an automatic system that decides for you. I do not like it.The soap dispenser is always wet and needs to be dried before putting powder in.Seems that the only way rinse aid can be adjusted is through the App, but when its done its done.We are happy with its performance on the 60 minute cycle and have not needed to do a different washWe wash at night when power is cheaper and the machine will send you a message at past midnight when its done - switch the messaging off through the AppWe needed our old cutlery basket for all those non cutlery items - and in the end we thought bugger it lets put all the cutlery in as before.Are we happy with it? :-Yes it does the job and things other than plastics and the tops of cups are pretty dry.Our old one was $324, 13 years ago and the new one NZ$1257. But it does open it door automatically. and we thought best of the bunch at the final price.A MONTH OR TWO DOWN THE TRACKWe have got to know the dishwasher better now. We still only use the 60 minute programme which works very well for us.We still use our old cutlery basket, but wait there's more:-The cutlery tray, we have found to be superbe for the longer knives, whisks and flippers various lids This means that the cutlery basket is just used for cutlery - (fork handles down prongs up) and the odd sized items are safely in the top draw. Haier seem to have played with the filter - it is much better to lock on and off and it seems to shoo out more rubbish out of the machine. We found very little to clean out after 4 weeks - mind you we do rinse the dishes first.We load it and set the delay for 11pm when the power rates change, we never hear it in operation and the next morning the door is open and everything is pretty much dry.Have to say the we bought the right one. The 2 year warranty is welcomed and we are very happy with it.

Sentence (English): A dishwasher was one of the items I absolutely had to buy when moving.
Comments (English): [ Improving quality of life ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher was one of the items I absolutely had to buy when moving. I set aside space for it during the interior renovation, purchased it in advance, and scheduled the installation for my preferred date. The technician installed it well and explained everything clearly, so I am using it happily. I usually wash the dishes for a simple breakfast and run it once after combining lunch and dinner. Since dinner is late, if I run it past 8 PM, it often ends up being past 10 PM. I saw many reviews saying the noise isn't loud, but as a first-time dishwasher user, I'm not sure if this level is actually quiet. Since I run it late at night, it is quiet, but if I pay close attention, I can hear the washing sound, which I suppose is to be expected. Regarding the high-temperature drying setting, I was told it wasn't actually high temperature, but if you set it, the door opens automatically. As for pre-washing? I just put in enough water for a quick rinse, and by morning, they are squeaky clean. I'm not very good at arranging dishes yet, but I'm sure my skills will improve over time. With the card discount and the Grade 1 cashback, I feel like I got a good deal. I am satisfied.

Sentence (English): My own review: First, I'm writing this review.
Comments (English): My own review: First, I'm writing this review. For a family of four, washing dishes took up a lot of my time. Both of us work, so doing dishes after work just flew by. I've always been told it's better to buy a larger dishwasher, but that would require drilling holes, which would mean contacting the landlord and potentially having to restore the dishwasher. I was debating, but then I found out that a friend I know also has a family of four and uses a Minix dishwasher. I asked her about it, and she said it didn't require drilling holes and that it wouldn't hold large items, but it was perfect for small dishes, spoons, and cups. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy it. The best part is the design! We bought the charcoal one, and the design and color are both beautiful. It sits on the countertop without compromising the design. I was worried it wouldn't hold much because it's a mini, but it holds more than I expected, including plates, cups, and spoons. I'm very satisfied with it! Even if I just wash the large dishes and pots that don't fit, the dishwasher handles all the smaller items, which is great. And most importantly, the cleaning power! As with all dishwashers, I rinse the dishes with water once before using them in standard mode to prolong their life. It removes grease very well and dries perfectly, so I love it. Cons: If I had to name a con, it would be that the dishes in the lunchboxes with seams or gaps might not dry as well due to their location, so for those, you can place them on the drying rack upside down after the wash mode is finished. Overall: The difficult times of my husband and I standing in the kitchen every day to wash dishes for a family of four are gone, and instead, I have more time to spend with my kids. Also, the stress of washing dishes after eating is gone! If you were hesitant to buy a large capacity, you should definitely buy one! Even if it's a mini, it will improve your quality of life!

Sentence (English): For a family of four, washing dishes took up a lot of my time.
Comments (English): My own review: First, I'm writing this review. For a family of four, washing dishes took up a lot of my time. Both of us work, so doing dishes after work just flew by. I've always been told it's better to buy a larger dishwasher, but that would require drilling holes, which would mean contacting the landlord and potentially having to restore the dishwasher. I was debating, but then I found out that a friend I know also has a family of four and uses a Minix dishwasher. I asked her about it, and she said it didn't require drilling holes and that it wouldn't hold large items, but it was perfect for small dishes, spoons, and cups. So, after much deliberation, I decided to buy it. The best part is the design! We bought the charcoal one, and the design and color are both beautiful. It sits on the countertop without compromising the design. I was worried it wouldn't hold much because it's a mini, but it holds more than I expected, including plates, cups, and spoons. I'm very satisfied with it! Even if I just wash the large dishes and pots that don't fit, the dishwasher handles all the smaller items, which is great. And most importantly, the cleaning power! As with all dishwashers, I rinse the dishes with water once before using them in standard mode to prolong their life. It removes grease very well and dries perfectly, so I love it. Cons: If I had to name a con, it would be that the dishes in the lunchboxes with seams or gaps might not dry as well due to their location, so for those, you can place them on the drying rack upside down after the wash mode is finished. Overall: The difficult times of my husband and I standing in the kitchen every day to wash dishes for a family of four are gone, and instead, I have more time to spend with my kids. Also, the stress of washing dishes after eating is gone! If you were hesitant to buy a large capacity, you should definitely buy one! Even if it's a mini, it will improve your quality of life!

Sentence (English): I trust LG when it comes to home appliances.
Comments (English): I trust LG when it comes to home appliances. This is my review of a dishwasher, a kitchen essential these days, after six months of actual use. Do I really need it? A technician came and did the installation. I don't understand, but there's nothing I can do. It's a bit unsettling, but I finished the installation. I'm satisfied with the product, but the installation is disappointing.

Sentence (English): Superior cleaning.
Comments (English): [ Superior cleaning/operation a pain ] || ---------------- || Superior cleaning. I tested it with a pot full of mac & cheese. My pot came out as clean as can be without having to use any of the advanced cleaning cycles. I love that the dishes dry because of the temperature of the water. There is no need for heating elements for the dry cycle, so, unlike my last dishwasher, plastic does not melt, and you don't have to worry about putting delicate dishes in the dishwasher. I love it for that. It is also extremely quiet that, unless you get close to it, you won't know it's running. The only thing I don't love about it is that you can only access basic functions from the control panel. Any changes you want to make ha to happen from an app on a cell phone. If your kids come to visit snd want to run the dishwasher, you have to have them download the app, then share a code, just so they can turn on the dishwasher. This makes it so much more difficult than it needs to be. Any change of cycles (and there are many great options) have to be done through the app, which makes the operation of it more difficult than it needs to be. It would be nice just to be able to look at the control panel, push a few buttons and go. Maybe if I were 20 years old and had a cell phone welded to my hand like most 20 year olds, it would make sense, but the way it is now, if my internet goes out (and it does frequently) I can't change my settings.

Comments (English): [ It is definitely said to be typical of LG. ] || ---------------- || After struggling with hand-washing dishes three times a day, I finally bought the LG Dios Objet Collection built-in dishwasher. It's virtually silent, so you can run it at night without any issues. It even dries perfectly, so you can just put it away in the morning! Adjusting the detergent level can be confusing at first, but after a few uses, you'll quickly get the hang of it. Overall, this appliance scores 100 points for design, cleaning power, noise reduction, and convenience. It reduces the stress of hand washing and even adds a sophisticated touch to the kitchen, making it truly worthy of the title "10% Rebate Appliance." I feel like my quality of life is improving every day.

Sentence (English): My Bosch failed after just 5 years.
Comments (English): [ Best dishwasher I have ever owned ] || ---------------- || My Bosch failed after just 5 years. Even though it was a high-end Benchmark Series, I was never happy with how thorough it cleaned and how narrow the tines were set that made it difficult to fit in my big american dishes. I went with this KitchenAid after doing exhaustive research on various models and various features. The key features I liked were the 50 sprayer jets, the Pro-Dry system, and the "maintenance free" filtration system. But I think it was a video of someone putting in dirty, unrinsed dishes into their KitchenAid and then showing them come out clean and bone dry that pushed me over the edge between other models. As soon as I got the dishwasher, I basically replicated all of the video footage I relied on in my decision. putting in dirty, just-scraped-not-rinsed, dishes and pots into the dishwasher, running them on NORMAL wash mode and with Pro-Dry enabled and having them come out cleaner than anything my Bosch ever did. Plastic especially. In my old Bosch, the plastics always felt like they had an oily "film" like feel to them. In the KitchenAid and with the ProDry feature, the plastic dishes/containers come out feeling clean and not oily or filmy. I am saving so much in water and energy to heat the water by no longer "pre-washing/pre-rinsing" my dishes before putting them into the dishwasher. Also, the upper, 3rd rack, is just simply amazing and so much more usable than the one in my Bosch. And who knew how much you would want/need to have an LED light inside the dishwasher until you got one. This dishwasher is quiet at 44dba but it is a little louder than my 42dba Bosch, but I don't really mind because the dishes come out so clean and dry it makes you wonder why you didn't buy this dishwasher years before.
